attributionCurrentReason.history_incompl: The bounded evidence window is incomplete.
attributionCurrentReason.ambiguous_order: The observation order is ambiguous; no actor is selected.

attributionCurrentReason.state_mismatch: Current bytes or mode do not match the recorded after-state.

attributionCurrentReason.missing_raw: Required raw evidence is missing or could not be verified.
attributionCurrentReason.scope_unknown: The source or workspace incarnation could not be verified.
attributionCurrentReason.stale: The baseline changed during this read; refresh to recheck.
attributionCurrentReason.unsupported: This backend or filesystem object is not supported by current evidence verification.
attributionCurrentReason.budget_exceeded: Fingerprint or evidence exceeded the bounded display budget.
attributionCurrentReason.cancelled: Verification was cancelled or reached its deadline.
